description: C++23 campaign runtime and SDL3/Vulkan client with native race/size/seed setup, asynchronous generation/loading, independent Player17 save slots, research, fleets, shipyard, construction, orbital, colony, settlement and surface workspaces. Existing species and planet artwork is packaged. Detailed graphics, orbital structures, diplomacy and audio remain in migration. No Godot or .NET runtime is required. Diagnostic timings are not an FPS guarantee.
